heading.en: How fast is the ripple growing?

hook.en: Drop a stone in a pond. The radius of the ripple grows at a steady rate, but its area grows faster and faster. Derivatives measure exactly how fast.
hook.kn: ಕೊಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲ್ಲು ಹಾಕಿ. ಅಲೆಯ ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಿರ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಇನ್ನೂ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಷ್ಟು ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಎಂದು ಅವಕಲಜಗಳು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Interpret dy/dx as a rate of change
Use the chain rule for related rates

narration.en: Drop a stone in a pond. The radius of the ripple grows at a steady rate, but its area grows faster and faster. Derivatives measure exactly how fast.
narration.kn: ಕೊಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲ್ಲು ಹಾಕಿ. ಅಲೆಯ ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯ ಸ್ಥಿರ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಇನ್ನೂ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಷ್ಟು ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಎಂದು ಅವಕಲಜಗಳು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: $\frac{dy}{dx}$ at $x = x_0$ is the rate of change of $y$ with respect to $x$ at that point. If $x$ and $y$ both depend on time $t$, then $\frac{dy}{dt} = \frac{dy}{dx} \cdot \frac{dx}{dt}$. In economics, the derivative of total cost (revenue) is the marginal cost (revenue).
body.kn: dy/dx ಎಂದರೆ x ಗೆ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷವಾಗಿ y ಬದಲಾಗುವ ದರ. x, y ಎರಡೂ ಸಮಯ t ಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದರೆ dy/dt = dy/dx × dx/dt.

narration.en: The derivative d y by d x is the rate at which y changes with x. When both depend on time, multiply: d y by d t equals d y by d x times d x by d t.
narration.kn: dy/dx ಎಂದರೆ x ಗೆ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷವಾಗಿ y ಬದಲಾಗುವ ದರ. x, y ಎರಡೂ ಸಮಯ t ಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದರೆ dy/dt = dy/dx × dx/dt.

title.en: A ripple: radius steady, area racing

say.en: A stone falls in a pond. The radius grows by 3 centimetres every second, so the circles are evenly spaced.
Area is pi r squared. Differentiate with respect to time using the chain rule.
On the graph of A against r, d A by d r is the slope of the tangent. The curve gets steeper, so equal steps in r add more and more area.
In economics the same derivative is called marginal. Marginal cost is d C by d x: the cost of one more unit.

narration.en: On the board: A ripple: radius steady, area racing.

title.en: How fast is the area growing?

caption.en: Yellow: A = πr². Green: the tangent at the current radius r; its slope is dA/dr = 2πr.

tryThis.en: Keep dr/dt = 3 and double r. What happens to dA/dt?

narration.en: Move r and the speed d r by d t. The rate of change of area is 2 pi r times d r by d t, so it grows with the radius even at a steady speed.

problem.en: The radius of a circle increases at 3 cm/s. How fast is its area increasing when r = 10 cm?

problem.en: The volume of a cube increases at 9 cm³/s. How fast is its surface area increasing when an edge is 10 cm?

steps.en: V = x³ ⇒ 9 = 3x² dx/dt = 300 dx/dt, so dx/dt = 0.03 cm/s.

points.kn: dy/dx ಎಂದರೆ x ಗೆ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷವಾಗಿ y ನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ದರ.

points.en: Marginal cost and revenue are derivatives of total cost and revenue.
points.kn: ಅಂಚಿನ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಒಟ್ಟು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯದ ಅವಕಲಜಗಳು.

homework.en: A balloon stays spherical. Find the rate at which its volume changes with respect to its radius when r = 10 cm.

narration.en: Recap. dy/dx is the rate of change of y with respect to x. Related rates: dy/dt = (dy/dx)(dx/dt). Marginal cost and revenue are derivatives of total cost and revenue.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. dy/dx ಎಂದರೆ x ಗೆ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷವಾಗಿ y ನ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯ ದರ. ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ದರಗಳು: dy/dt = (dy/dx)(dx/dt). ಅಂಚಿನ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಒಟ್ಟು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯದ ಅವಕಲಜಗಳು.
